limitations: SNS publish Number admission is not the numeric filter operand domain; no filter operand claims are made here.

The boundary captures contain admission responses, not native subscription deliveries. Local SNS-to-SQS consumption additionally checks accepted boundary values remain deliverable with original wrapper spelling, generalizing the direct delivery evidence in admission.json.

Native SendMessage hashes submitted numeric spelling, while ReceiveMessage exposes normalized numeric text and its different checksum. Replay compares both actual native responses; a send checksum is not an oracle for stored text. Earlier successful SQS admission-only rows are replaced by receipt-backed cases to avoid duplicate tests.

Topic ARNs and queue URLs are rebound to isolated local dependencies. SNS subscription and exact-topic SQS policy setup for the boundary capture are local test dependencies, not manufactured native observations.
Only captured SNS/SQS pairs are claimed as paired evidence; precision-38/39, dot grammar, and NaN cases in the earlier limits capture are SNS-only.
